item.mimieffects.note_scroll.hold_shift: Hold SHIFT for which instruments to play

mimieffects.command.reload.success: [MIMI Effects] Tracks loaded: %s. New stubs created: %s.

mimieffects.command.clearscrolls.confirm: [MIMI Effects] This resets EVERY track's instruments/effects/mob_purge back to a blank stub so they can be regenerated by /mimieffects genscrolls. Run '/mimieffects clearscrolls confirm' to actually do it.
mimieffects.command.clearscrolls.success: [MIMI Effects] Reset %s track(s) back to unconfigured stubs.
mimieffects.editor.error.no_permission: [MIMI Effects] Insufficient permissions to save (needs OP level 2+).
mimieffects.editor.error.invalid_json: [MIMI Effects] Invalid JSON — save cancelled, old file untouched.
mimieffects.editor.error.io: [MIMI Effects] Server-side file write error (see server log).
mimieffects.editor.title: MIMI Effects — Track Editor
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.base_level: Effect level (amplifier) at the minimum qualifying ensemble size.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.max_level: Effect level (amplifier) cap once the ensemble scaling bonuses max out.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.effect_min_pl: How many players in the ensemble must be present before THIS specific effect joins in (1 = always on once the arrangement itself matches). Lets one arrangement layer effects by ensemble size.
mimieffects.editor.min_ensemble_size: Min. ensemble size (blank = no hard gate)
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.min_ensemble_: Hard headcount floor, independent of which instruments are present — below this many players in the ensemble, this arrangement produces NO effect at all. Blank = no gate (the pre-existing default).
mimieffects.editor.label.spell_name: Scroll name (the "spell", shown as the item's name)
mimieffects.editor.label.artist: Artist (optional, shown in the scroll's tooltip)
mimieffects.editor.section.instruments: Instruments — pick an instrument and set a count:
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.mob_purge: Periodically damages and eventually kills qualifying mobs near the player while this track plays.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.radius_blocks: How far from the player mob purge scans, in blocks.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.max_radius_bl: Optional: lets the purge radius grow with ensemble size, up to this cap — effective radius = min(this, radius x player count). Leave blank to keep the radius flat.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.environment: Which mobs qualify by where they physically are: on the surface, underwater, or either.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.static_only: Only trigger purge when played on a block (stationary) instrument, not a handheld one.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.hostile_only: Only purge hostile mobs, not passive/ambient ones.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.silent: Currently has no effect — kept only for compatibility with older track files.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.target.player: Give the effect to nearby players.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.target.friend: Give the effect to friendly (passive) entities.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.target.hostil: Give the effect to hostile entities.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.target.neutra: Give the effect to neutral entities.
mimieffects.editor.tooltip.target.orches: Give the effect to other ensemble members too.
mimieffects.editor.status.invalid_json: Invalid JSON in this file, can't edit: %s
